policy.formalized: Only claims explicitly scoped by a linked formal theorem and its source scope note are marked lean_formalization_scope_documented. A paper's stronger statement is a separate manuscript-only claim unless a corresponding theorem is identified.
policy.exactness: Exact coefficient arithmetic does not imply deterministic solver correctness. Solver mode, proof/certificate model and output contract are separate fields.
policy.independent_reproduction: A repository theorem citation is not an assertion that this Symthaea environment independently rebuilt the Lean project.
policy.peer_review: Preprint, internal formalization, external review and peer-reviewed publication are separate evidence dimensions.

sources.provenance_note: The source describes mixed human/AI-generated text and names Claude/Claude Code/Python in its release metadata.

claims.input_encoding: OpenAI math repository canonical CNF encoding; bit length L
claims.machine_model: deterministic primitive machine as represented in the Lean development

The claim does not cover arbitrary SAT encodings, arbitrary output algebras, PMC/PWMC, or complex weighted counting.
This is a formalization-scope citation, not an independent external mathematical review.
